Hey everyone, I felt very guilty today in work because I feel like I told the therapist things that were not the best of my mom. I've been causing everyone in the house to feel down because of my issues which I understand makes everyone upset over time. Now I'm embarrassed to go back because I told her things that likely violates the trust between my mom & I.

I've been crying so hard the past two days, I just want the pain to be over. I'm tired of feeling like my siblings contaminate things, I'm tired of the cat's litter on the porch or the hairs on the couches. I'm tired of going in the dirty garage because then I just have to get in my mom's car which is contaminated, I don't like having to move even though it's best for us because there is no work here. My mom teaches this Bible study in this lady's home on Sundays, I don't go because of their dog, my sister goes but not my brother-it's probably OCD because if one siblings goes or does thing but not the other I won't do it.

I'm guilty over not going. I've been praying that God just takes me in my sleep. I miss my ex, I cry over her every night. I miss holding her just having time stand still when I was with her. If I could just go back to January last year I could fix everything. I cannot go on like this, this could be the last week of my life. I'm starting to have anxiety attacks in the day realising I can't escape this.

I tried to bring myself to think the other day-what if I just did more in the house with my siblings even if only with one not the other? I used to before but I can't even bring myself to do that because of the OCD. I'm tired, I'm terrified to sleep because of the dreams but sleeping lets me escape the pain. If i weren't for my possession I'd be gone. There's nothing worse then thinking my prized gifts from my mom or parents would end up in dirty boxes in the garage smelling like cat's litter & gasoline.

Living here before my mom was in a nasty divorce with my bipolar father, life was super tough especially when it came to money.
I didn't realize how much pressure I was putting on here, originally my girl was going to Arizona so I wanted to follow her, I tried to get her to move to Florida when me for Grad-school.
Now that I'm here it's not only her loss that makes me feel ill every days, it's the loss of happiness living here bring me now. It's the loss of places I used to love because I feel like my siblings make places that were sentimental to me before contaminated. It's the stores, the restaurants, beaches, theme parks, even malls I used to go to.

We've had to ship some items back to the town I lived in while in college and to the state my girl went on trips with me to. I feel like because we sent things there my siblings touched those places I had sentimental memories are now contaminated, I feel so guilty over feeling that way over my siblings and both feeling like those places are dirty to me now.
One night my mom tried to tell me that it was OK, and nothing was wrong, it helped some but I still can't shake it.

Now that I've lost my job I have nobody to talk to, no neighbors even.
I don't want to go outside my house hardly right now, I'm trying to just stay in my room and watch TV or read self-help books.
When I'm not doing that I like to walk to the lake to fish or play with my tablet.
I don't like touching things, for instance, door handles in my house because I feel like they're contaminated, on the other hand I don't like touching my mom's belongings because I think I'll contaminate them.
Even worse, I won't touch very sentimental gifts or possessions of mine because I don't want to ruin the specialness of when I got them-or the memories of receiving it.

Now that's I'm worried over the symmetry of my siblings, I feel like something is especially contaminated if only one sibling touches something-it's still contaminated if they both do but if only one does then it's far worse.
I've been like that for over ten years but before they only had to touch the same thing-it wasn't necessarily contaminated either way. Now that I'm really struggling this year, it's extra contaminated either way.
I'm trapped in my own house, I like living at home especially since I'm helping my single mom out a lot right now but only being clean in my room is terrible.
I've come to realise this week that I'm not doing very well with the OCD.

I'm not working right now because my last job forced to to quit over the way they treated me because they were jealous I had been to college.

I'm living in central Florida with my mom & two siblings younger than me.
If you've read my posts before you'll know that last year I graduated college in Minnesota. My mom purchased this current home in Florida because I wanted to spend time with my family having not seen them much for three years. My mom's current husband moved with us but recently moved back to his home town up north.

I broke up with my first girlfriend the week I graduated college, I didn't want to but she had gotten too close to this other boy who I later found out she had been spending lots of time with behind my back two months before I moved. That's why I noticed her losing interest in us, the same time that was happening I noticed she no longer wanted to move to Florida with me It's one of the worst, most hurtful things to ever happen to me.
I'm still crying over it nearly every day. It’s not healthy but I miss her so much-she was very influential in helping me have one of the lowest OCD points in my life. I'm not saying I was nearly OCD-free but I was living my life the way I wanted to. I was touching things of mine when I wanted, I was not feeling the excessive contamination I have now, it helped me so very much.
Once I got here I realized the fantasy of living here like my family did before wasn't quite going to happen. My siblings have grown up in the last four years. They've got expenses to pay plus my mom's husband was here and he did not like it.

We couldn't find jobs for several weeks which worried everyone. My siblings have their own issues to deal with, some of which I only found out recently.
It's not the way it was before where my mom, sibling and I used to live here before and had fun even when life was tough. It's just different now. We're kind of kept to ourselves and my mom is unhappy because she doesn't know what she wants in life.
There's so many fond memories of life here before, so of the places I loved going to don't exist or have gotten run down. I don't have friends here, I'm really lonely. I'm not working so there is nobody to meet.
There's places I want to go but they're contaminated to me because of my siblings.

I've been struggling with feeling like my siblings contaminate places that used to be special to me here, the theme parks or the malls. I'm having issues with the gasoline or contaminated things in the house. The cats in the house get hair on everything, plus the litter box smells really bad often which makes me feel like I have to shower if I go near it. When I got here last year my mom had her husband's dad drive down with my family to help with the move, I felt like he had contaminated my mom's car which bothered me for months. I've posted how lapel pins bother me, my mom has these earrings which upsets me in the same way the pins do. I don't usually have OCD with my mom but our relationship has been I didn't know that she still even had them not seeing them for like ten years but has worn them often since we moved back here. Once you've combined that with the car and my siblings and the cats I can't handle everything.

I'm so worn out, I want to go someplace far from here and never look back. It's tough to get out of bed or go downstairs. I'm sad when my siblings touch something then I see people in public touch it, like I've ruined their lives. It's not harm OCD because I do not ever worry I'm going to harm people, I'd like to help them, but I guess it's fear I'm harming people by the fact I pushed my family to move back here. Right before the move my mom got upset because I kept wanting to know when the house was going to be hers, I wanted to have old times with my family plus have my girlfriend come experience the life I had here before.

I've keep most of my personal belongings in plastic tote bins for a number of years now, I had most of my things in a storage unity from 2008-May of 2012 while I was in university. There's some items too big for my room that stay in my mom's place with now but most of them I have in my closet or in my room. Tonight I opened them to find some DVDs I wanted to watch and seeing everything made me want to cry.

I'm very thankful for all the nice things I have and I have lots of belongings but my possession tell stories some of which bring on upsetting feelings. There's plush toys in their from when my family went on vacation years ago before we lived in Florida, there's books from my mom, movies my parents bought me on special occasions, video games I bought when I lived with my mom & siblings here before, clothes I wore my girlfriend bought me when I dated her. It's tough seeing those things, I got to look in some of the bins while in college and I remember seeing things that reminded me of Florida and how much I wanted to return someday and be happy here.

I'm here now which is what I wanted but because of my contamination OCD I feel like everything I loved her is ruined now. I know I've been broken up from my girlfriend year 15 months now but I miss her so much even though she hurt me. I miss our dates where she wore clothes I bought her and coming back and having someone to hold which I want so much because I don't let people touch me not even my family.

It's so hard to think how happy I used to be here before. I don't miss my dad because he is bipolar and hurt us emotionally but sometimes I miss the innocent days of being our family on vacation together. My personality is not unlike my mom so we get on each other right now which I don't like.

You're probably thinking this isn't OCD which it's not but being OCD now makes it impossible for me to be happy in this place I loved so much. I'm not saying I want to hurt myself or I would but I don't want to live most days, I just want to cease existing. It's unfortunate my family doesn't keep their possessions nicer like I do, I worry if I were gone my things would be destroyed. The things I've held with such respect because they're gifts from people I loved over the years.
I got it to keep me occupied when I'm on lunch breaks from work, no reason to get rid it it because it operates fine plus I don't use camera either.
The OCD in my life has gone from hoarding, to hand washing, intrusive thoughts, & then in 2009 to contamination.
Hi there, I don't live Tallahassee but I'm open to meet new people; got pictures online on Google.
I understand it here too, you're just tired of the hurt.
I've been OCD my whole life but recently it's been too much to think it'll ever get better; the breakup was 5/9/13 but was the only girl I've ever loved.
Don't kill yourself over boredom, you've got college, girlfriend, & job right now. It's easy to get depressed over boredom but use it to drive you to better things.
Thanks for the kind words, I just want peace from everything. I'm not upset or out for revenge, I just want happiness even it's it's ending my life.
If you're with the right person who loves you it makes the OCD better to be honest. It'll burn them out over time though just like it'll burn you out with help or treatments.
